symbols.name: Unpacker final read and exit
symbols.detail: Last compressed-byte read through $FE/$FF, then the exit that restores the processor port, enables IRQs and jumps to $0801.

symbols.name: Release picture Space wait
symbols.detail: Compares CIA1 port B with $FF until Space is pressed on the original release picture.

symbols.name: Title control sampling
symbols.detail: Original routine where the title samples host controls (N for new commander, F1 for launch); entry point.

symbols.name: Title animation JSR $B60C
symbols.detail: Ordinary title animation reaches JSR $B60C here after poll 608 (single instruction site).
